async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the user profile page using the relative URL
    await page.goto('/byteblaze')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now on the user profile page, look for the status setting
    # Try to find an 'Edit profile' button or link first
    try:
        edit_button = page.get_by_role('link', name='Edit profile')
        await edit_button.click()
    except:
        try:
            # Alternatively, look for a button to set status directly
            status_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Set status')
            await status_button.click()
        except:
            # If not found, print the current page title for debugging
            print(await page.title())
            return
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Find the input field for status and set it
    try:
        status_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Status')
        await status_input.fill('Resting due to leg injury')
    except:
        try:
            # If no specific textbox, try a generic input
            status_input = page.get_by_role('textbox')
            await status_input.fill('Resting due to leg injury')
        except:
            print('Status input not found')
            return
    # Find and click the save or update button
    try:
        save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
        await save_button.click()
    except:
        try:
            update_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Update')
            await update_button.click()
        except:
            # If no save button, press Enter on the input
            await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Print confirmation
    print('Status set to Resting due to leg injury')
